briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and Google Gemini-3 escalate frontier model race amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 11 new models this month with accelerated scaling. Compute shortages and regulatory delays shape deployment timelines. Global AI investment hit $14.2B this quarter.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI launched Orion-2 achieving 92% on GPQA. Anthropic's Claude 4.5 and xAI's Grok-3 follow closely. Meta open-sourced Llama-4 weights under new safety tier.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began 2nm AI chip production. Microsoft and Google announced 50GW data center expansions. NVIDIA Blackwell supply constraints persist into Q4.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese consortium by 2028?
